The first part (phase 1: chart builder + saved views) is targeted to be feature-complete behind the `dash_v2` flag by Dec 4, with the design-partner beta opening Wednesday Dec 9 [1][3].

That beta is limited to 5 customers — Orbitly, Zest Grocers and three accounts from the October trial cohort; other customers won't get access before general availability, targeted for late January but explicitly not committed [3]. Priya also asked the team not to promise access to anyone outside that list, with a waitlist opening in January [7].
